subpages.text: Home Welcome! Welcome to Dragonbard.com Our little patch of virtual reality About us Welcome to Dragonbard.com! This is our family website where (eventually) there should be lots of fun stuff about us. This is a new version of our site as of December 2008. It’s a work in process. Â (Aren't we cute?) Â We’re a family of 4… the Bard, the Mama, a CareBear (2 years old) and a LiliBee (1 year old). We also share our home with 2 cats, 2 dogs, a snake and a bunch of fish. The Bard is a techie (network admin) by trade, the Mama is a lab rat (medical technologist/microbiologist) turned stay at home mom.
